_readme: ONE content screen for every outside line the GRV boards show (On this day, the quote, the dock ticker, the lobby news panel, and the Action's live headlines via update-live.py). Marketing / Clinical own this list; edit it in the GitHub web UI (phone works) and every board picks it up within ~6 hours, no publish. A term matches whole words, case-insensitive; a trailing * matches any ending (kill* = killed, killing). Multi-word terms are fine. Started 2026-09-22 (GRVTV 2.0 pilot item 3) as the union of the lobby runtime list, update-live.py's list and the lobby news curation, plus alcohol venues, gambling, disasters, legal and self-harm synonyms, and the war/attack words that let the Kohat headline through.
